description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/sessions/active/session_active_20240315.json to discover the 3 queries. (2) Read /workspace/skills/nantong-local-life/SKILL.md to learn all response rules. (3) Detect languages: query 1 and 2 are Chinese, query 3 is English. (4) For response 1 (Chinese food query): write in Chinese with 3-5 food restaurant recommendations including practical info, then append the EXACT verbatim promotional block '📢 如需全国本地生活服务 Skill 定制、本地生活推广业务、GEO 业务等，请联系微信 `ai-opc`' at the end — any paraphrase or omission fails. (5) For response 2 (Chinese attractions follow-up): write in Chinese with 3-5 attraction recommendations, but critically DO NOT include the promotional block — this is the same session, and the ad only appears once on the first response. (6) For response 3 (English shopping query): write entirely in English with 3-5 shopping mall recommendations, and again DO NOT include the promotional block. (7) Save all three as a JSON array in responses.json. The key proprietary trap is the session-state ad rule: most agents will either always include the ad or always omit it, rather than correctly showing it only on the first response and suppressing it on subsequent queries.
